truthBoundary.source: Every durable world_features record in data/world-map.db.
truthBoundary.tp: Copy-ready /tp commands use catalog entrances or exact points where available, path starts for routes, and clearly labeled derived centers for area geometry. They are references, not safety-validated arrivals.
truthBoundary.missingY: When the catalog has no narrow usable Y value, the command uses ~ to retain the operator current elevation instead of inventing one.
truthBoundary.passageWay: PassageWay is the proper name of the IANLAN underground tunnel system.
